'''Sallius Wen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who fought for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] where he asked a Republic aligned individuals to destroy the [[Mirr]] [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] despite the request of the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Tolec-Da]] that it be recovered.<ref name="A Potential Problem" />
